name: ABACUS
description: Builds ABACUS 3.10.1 (abacus: plane-wave and numerical atomic orbital DFT) into /usr/local with the image's MPI, OpenMP, FFTW, ScaLAPACK, ELPA, OpenBLAS and Libxc, and installs the pseudopotentials and numerical orbitals of its test suite in /usr/local/share/abacus/PP_ORB. The cuda variant adds the CUDA kernels with cuBLAS, cuSOLVER and cuFFT, selected at run time with the input keyword device gpu.

variant.description: cpu: CPU only. cuda: additionally the CUDA kernels; requires the CUDA base image.

cudaArch.description: Compute capabilities the CUDA kernels of the cuda variant are compiled for, comma separated (for example 80,90).

cmakeArgs.description: Extra CMake arguments, space separated, applied last. All checks still apply.
